reviews.title: It has 8 cores
reviews.comment: I simply upgraded from the i3 10100, and I thought I wouldn't see much of an upgrade, as typically cores don't matter to much when it comes to gaming. But Gosh dang my computer feels at least 150% faster overall when it comes to basic tasks. It was a simple installation of swapping the old CPU with the new one and instantly seeing the difference. Being a 65w chip, means it is very easy to cool. This CPU does a great job of supporting my graphics card. My old CPU was getting an occasional freeze or studder on modern games. Where the game I was playing would freeze for multiple seconds and then eventually recover... But now not only is it gone, but I have seen a 20FPS on average uplift which took me from 70-80 FPS to 90-100FPS in the more demanding titles. I wouldn't pay the new price ATM, I would buy it used. As $300+ is stupid for a CPU that is 6 years old, but it kinda is a hard tell for the current stagnation of PC building right now with AI taking up all the DDR5. I bought this processor for $133 used, and I think for that price it is worth it.
reviews.author: Kyle

reviews.title: Take your time and find the right bios update and cpu update.
reviews.comment: Normally, you wouldn’t get a big boost from a processor upgrade, but I went from an I-5 10400 with 64 gigs of vengeance corsair ram and a Zortech 12 gig GeForce RTX and I put this processor in and let me tell you it is a tremendous upgrade when you set it up right and set up your system right I love it even though it was used absolute mint condition. Thank you very much.

reviews.title: Intel i7-10700F w/ OC.
reviews.comment: It was installed and works well. Used Corsair TM30 thermal compound and temps at after overclocking max out around 78°C. Awesome price and was well within my budget for my rig. Does what I need it to.
